name: food-ordering-web-application
description:
Food Ordering Web Application — EPIC: Menu Viewing
1 story
US-001
View Menu Items
As customer, I want to view a list of food items with their name, price, and image, so that I can choose what to order.

Fields
3
• Name
• Price
• Image
Validations
2
• All food items are listed with complete information
================================================================================
Acceptance Criteria
3
Given I am on the Menu Page
When I open the website
Then I see all available food items with their name, price, and image
EPIC: Cart Management
4 stories
US-002
Add Items to Cart
As customer, I want to add food items to my cart from the menu, so that I can order multiple items at once.

Fields
1
• Food item selection
Validations
2
• Item is added to cart only once per click
================================================================================
Acceptance Criteria
3
Given I am viewing the Menu Page
When I click "Add to Cart" on a food item
Then that item appears in my cart
US-003
Remove Items from Cart
As customer, I want to remove items from my cart, so that I can update my order before checkout.

Fields
1
• Cart items
Validations
2
• Removed item no longer appears in cart
================================================================================
Acceptance Criteria
3
Given I have items in my cart
When I click "Remove" on a cart item
Then that item is removed from my cart
US-004
Change Item Quantity in Cart
As customer, I want to change the quantity of items in my cart, so that I can adjust how much food I order.

Fields
2
• Cart items
• Quantity
Validations
2
• Quantity must be a positive integer
================================================================================
Acceptance Criteria
3
Given I have items in my cart
When I change the quantity of an item
Then the total price updates accordingly
US-005
View Cart and Total Price
As customer, I want to view my cart with all selected items and the total price, so that I can review my order before checking out.

Fields
3
• Cart items
• Quantity
• Total price
Validations
2
• Total price accurately sums all items
================================================================================
Acceptance Criteria
3
Given I have added items to my cart
When I view the Cart Page
Then I see a list of items with their quantities and the total price
EPIC: Checkout Process
2 stories
US-006
Enter Checkout Details
As customer, I want to enter my name, phone number, and address during checkout, so that my order can be delivered correctly.

Fields
3
• Name
• Phone number
• Address
Validations
2
• All fields must be filled before placing an order
================================================================================
Acceptance Criteria
3
Given I am on the Checkout Page
When I enter my name, phone number, and address
Then the system accepts the information for order placement
US-007
Place Order
As customer, I want to place my order after entering my details, so that my request is submitted for processing.

Fields
4
• Cart contents
• Name
• Phone number
• Address
Validations
2
• Order cannot be placed with missing information
================================================================================
Acceptance Criteria
3
Given I have entered all required checkout information
When I click "Place Order"
Then my order is submitted and processed
EPIC: Order Confirmation
2 stories
US-008
Display Order Confirmation Message
As customer, I want to see a confirmation message after placing my order, so that I know my order was successful.

Fields
1
• Confirmation message
Validations
2
• Message appears only after successful order placement
================================================================================
Acceptance Criteria
3
Given I have placed an order
When the order is processed
Then I see a message: "Order placed successfully"
US-009
Show Order Summary
As customer, I want to see a summary of my order after placing it, so that I can review what I have ordered.

Fields
6
• Ordered items
• Quantities
• Total price
• Name
• Phone number
• Address
Validations
2
• All order information is displayed accurately
================================================================================
Acceptance Criteria
3
Given my order has been placed
When I am on the Confirmation Page
Then I see a list of ordered items, quantities, total price, and my delivery details
generate the javascriptcodebase for the above attched user stories
